$comment: Policy for the submission intake service. Committed on purpose: changing a spam threshold should be a pull request someone can object to, not something that happened on a server. docs/trd.md §4.

dedupe.$comment: Matches scripts/validate-data.ts, which rejects same-name-within-100m at merge time. Catching it at intake means telling the submitter, instead of failing CI on a pull request nobody can fix.

$flags: Soft holds reach the pull request flagged; hard fails are dropped without a trace — nothing tallies them. Never the reverse — a wrong accept costs a review comment, a wrong reject is a silent deletion.
